_comment: Ground truth for OWASP pygoat — a real, third-party intentionally-vulnerable
Django app — used as an external validation target for Autopsy.
into this repo; clone it yourself (see benchmark/pygoat/README.md).
Every entry below was verified by reading introduction/views.py directly and
confirming user input reaches the sink; line numbers are from that commit and
may shift in other revisions — re-verify if you use a different checkout.
Scope: only CODE-LEVEL, AST-detectable vulnerabilities in Autopsy's categories
are listed. pygoat also contains OWASP issues that are NOT statically decidable
from source (security misconfiguration, vulnerable components, business-logic
access-control, SSTI-by-render) — those are deliberately excluded rather than
guessed. The SSTI lab's os.path.join uses a server-generated UUID (not user
input), so it is NOT a path-traversal finding and was excluded.
Categories are normalized by eval.py (e.g. 'Command Injection' -> command).

vulnerabilities.description: sql_lab: name/password from POST concatenated into a SQL string passed to login.objects.raw() (sink at line 162).
insec_des_lab: pickle.loads() on a base64-decoded user-controlled cookie (sink at line 214).
cmd_lab: user 'domain' formatted into a shell command run via subprocess.Popen(shell=True) (build line 424, sink line 430).
cmd_lab2: eval() called directly on user POST input 'val' (sink at line 460).
a9_lab: yaml.load() with yaml.Loader on an uploaded file, allowing arbitrary object construction (sink at line 560).
injection_sql_lab: name/password from POST concatenated into SQL passed to sql_lab_table.objects.raw() (build line 864, sink line 878).
ssrf_lab2: requests.get() on a user-supplied URL with no allowlist (sink at line 963).
crypto_failure_lab: MD5 used to hash a user password (sink at line 1026).
xxe_parse: SAX parser with feature_external_ges enabled (line 259) parses the raw user request body (line 260) -> XML External Entity injection.
a9_lab2: ImageMath.eval() evaluates a user-supplied 'function' expression (sink at line 588) -> arbitrary code execution.

ssti_lab: user-supplied blog content is written into a Django template file (line 996) that is later rendered by ssti_view_blog -> server-side template injection. Cross-function; the hardest of the set to detect statically.
